title: Jurassic Park
description: 80 questions about the Jurassic Park story and its dinosaurs, from the first film to Jurassic World, Dominion and Camp Cretaceous. Each game asks you 10.

questions.text: On which island is Jurassic Park built?
questions.explanation: The park is on the fictional island of Isla Nublar, off the coast of Costa Rica.

questions.text: Which company builds the park's dinosaurs?
questions.explanation: InGen stands for International Genetic Technologies.

questions.text: Who founded Jurassic Park?
questions.explanation: John Hammond wants to show the world living dinosaurs.

questions.text: Who is the park's lead geneticist?
questions.explanation: Dr. Henry Wu is the scientist who leads the work on the dinosaurs' genes.

questions.text: What does Dr. Alan Grant study?
questions.explanation: Alan Grant is a paleontologist: he studies fossils of ancient animals.

questions.text: What does Dr. Ellie Sattler study?
questions.explanation: Ellie is a paleobotanist. She studies plants that lived millions of years ago.

questions.text: Which programmer disables the park's security so he can steal dinosaur embryos?
questions.explanation: Nedry switches off the security system to reach the embryo storage room, and the dinosaurs escape.

questions.text: How does Dennis Nedry die in the first film?
questions.explanation: After his car gets stuck in mud during the storm, a Dilophosaurus finds him.

options.text: A T. rex stamps on him

questions.text: What keeps the dinosaurs inside their enclosures in the first film?
questions.explanation: Nedry turns off the computers that run the electric fences.

questions.text: Which two children are John Hammond's grandchildren in the first film?
questions.explanation: Lex and Tim visit the park with their grandfather, and they are in danger when the park fails.

questions.text: Why does John Hammond want to open the park?
questions.explanation: Hammond wants visitors to see dinosaurs up close, in a theme park.

options.text: To find gold on the island

questions.text: Who wrote the 1990 novel Jurassic Park?
questions.explanation: Michael Crichton wrote the novel that the first film is based on.

questions.text: Where do the scientists find dinosaur blood?
questions.explanation: A mosquito that had fed on a dinosaur was trapped in tree resin, which hardened into amber.

options.text: In a mosquito trapped in amber
In dinosaur eggs in a museum

questions.text: What is amber?
questions.explanation: Amber is tree sap that has hardened over millions of years. Insects can be trapped in it.

questions.text: What fills the gaps in the dinosaur DNA in the first film?
questions.explanation: The gaps in the recovered DNA are filled with frog DNA.

questions.text: What does Ian Malcolm mean by 'life finds a way'?
questions.explanation: Malcolm warns that nature escapes human control.

questions.text: What does the T. rex do during the rainstorm in the first film?
questions.explanation: The T. rex breaks out of its enclosure and attacks the tour vehicles in heavy rain.

options.text: It breaks out and chases the tour jeeps
It sleeps in the visitor centre

questions.text: Which dinosaurs hunt Lex and Tim in the park's kitchen?
questions.explanation: Velociraptors come into the kitchen while the children are inside.

questions.text: Who says 'Clever girl' about a velociraptor?
questions.explanation: Muldoon, the park's game warden, says it as a raptor attacks him.

questions.text: What is the first live dinosaur the group sees in the park?
questions.explanation: A Brachiosaurus feeds from the treetops, seen from the group's jeep.

questions.text: What does the T. rex do at the visitor centre at the end of the first film?
questions.explanation: The T. rex attacks the raptors inside the visitor centre, and the group escapes.

options.text: It fights the raptors and saves the group
It falls asleep in the jungle

questions.text: In the first film, the Dilophosaurus spits venom. Is that true of the real animal?
questions.explanation: Real Dilophosaurus had two crests on its head and no frill. The venom and frill were invented for the film.

options.text: No: the venom was made up for the film
Yes, it spat at its prey
Yes, it is a venomous lizard

questions.text: Where is Site B, the island where the dinosaurs were bred, in The Lost World?
questions.explanation: Isla Sorna is InGen's Site B.

questions.text: What happens to the T. rex brought to San Diego in The Lost World?
questions.explanation: A freighter crash in San Diego releases the T. rex, which rampages through the city.

options.text: It escapes and runs through the city
It is sent back to the island
It is put in a museum
It is set free in the ocean

questions.text: Which huge dinosaur fights the T. rex in Jurassic Park III?
questions.explanation: Spinosaurus, with a large sail on its back, defeats the T. rex.

questions.text: What is the ball-shaped vehicle visitors ride in Jurassic World?
questions.explanation: The gyrosphere is a rolling, ball-shaped vehicle that carries visitors among the dinosaurs.

questions.text: Which hybrid dinosaur escapes in Jurassic World?
questions.explanation: Dr. Henry Wu's team makes the Indominus rex from mixed DNA. It is a hybrid.

questions.text: What is the name of the velociraptor in Owen Grady's pack in Jurassic World?
questions.explanation: Owen Grady, a raptor trainer, works with a pack that includes Blue.

questions.text: Which giant sea reptile lives in the Jurassic World lagoon?
questions.explanation: A Mosasaurus is a marine reptile, not a dinosaur.

questions.text: What threatens the dinosaurs on Isla Nublar in Fallen Kingdom?
questions.explanation: The volcano on Isla Nublar erupts, and Owen and Claire return to rescue the dinosaurs.

questions.text: Where do dinosaurs live in Jurassic World Dominion?
questions.explanation: By Dominion, dinosaurs have spread into the human world.

options.text: Among people, all around the world

questions.text: What threatens crops in Jurassic World Dominion?
questions.explanation: Biosyn's scientists create engineered locusts that damage crops.

questions.text: Where is Biosyn's dinosaur preserve in Jurassic World Dominion?
questions.explanation: The story's climax takes place at the preserve in Italy's Dolomites.

options.text: In the Dolomite mountains of Italy

questions.text: How many years after the first park does Jurassic World open?
questions.explanation: Jurassic World opens on Isla Nublar 22 years after the original park.

questions.text: What kind of show is Camp Cretaceous?
questions.explanation: Camp Cretaceous is an animated series from DreamWorks Animation, shown on Netflix.

questions.text: What is the trip the teenagers are on in Camp Cretaceous?
questions.explanation: When the dinosaurs get loose, the campers are cut off from the outside world.

options.text: A summer camp on Isla Nublar
A school trip to a museum

questions.text: How many teenagers are the main campers in Camp Cretaceous?
questions.explanation: Six teenagers are stranded at a camp on the far side of Isla Nublar.

questions.text: Who is the park's operations manager in Jurassic World?
questions.explanation: Claire Dearing runs park operations.

questions.text: What does Tyrannosaurus rex mean?
questions.explanation: The name combines Greek for 'tyrant' and Latin for 'king'.

questions.text: What does Triceratops mean?
questions.explanation: The name refers to the three horns on its face.

questions.text: What does Velociraptor mean?
questions.explanation: Velociraptor means 'speedy thief'.

questions.text: What does Gallimimus mean?
questions.explanation: The name comes from Latin words for chicken and mimic.

questions.text: What does Dilophosaurus mean?
questions.explanation: It was named for the two thin crests on its skull.

questions.text: What does Pteranodon mean?
questions.explanation: Pteranodon was a flying reptile, not a dinosaur.

questions.text: How many fingers does a T. rex have on each arm?
questions.explanation: Its short arms each had two fingers.

questions.text: What is the velociraptor's famous feature on its feet?
questions.explanation: Velociraptor had a sickle-shaped claw on its second toe.

options.text: A large, curved claw on each second toe

questions.text: How big were real velociraptors compared with the film's?
questions.explanation: The film's raptors are much bigger. Real velociraptors were roughly turkey-sized.

options.text: About the size of a turkey
About the size of a horse
About the size of a car
About the size of a bus

questions.text: What covered many raptors, including Velociraptor?
questions.explanation: Velociraptor forearm bones show bumps where feathers were anchored.

questions.text: What is Brachiosaurus famous for?
questions.explanation: Its long neck let it reach leaves high in the trees.

questions.text: What is the frill on Triceratops?
questions.explanation: The bony frill covers the back of its head and neck.

options.text: A large bony shield at the back of the head
A row of spikes on the tail

questions.text: What covers the back of Stegosaurus?
questions.explanation: Stegosaurus had plates along its back and spikes on its tail.

options.text: A hard shell like a turtle

questions.text: What is the name for the spiked tail of Stegosaurus?
questions.explanation: Cartoonist Gary Larson coined the name as a joke in The Far Side.

questions.text: Which dinosaur had a heavy bony club at the end of its tail?
questions.explanation: Ankylosaurus's tail ended in a bony club, probably used for defence.

questions.text: What is unusual about Gallimimus's mouth?
questions.explanation: Gallimimus was toothless and had a beak.

options.text: It had three rows of teeth

questions.text: What is the long crest on Parasaurolophus's head?
questions.explanation: The hollow crest probably helped it make loud sounds.

questions.text: How big was Compsognathus?
questions.explanation: Compsognathus was a small, light dinosaur.

options.text: About the size of a chicken
About the size of a bear
About the size of a sofa
About the size of a bus

questions.text: Dimetrodon has a big sail on its back. What is it?
questions.explanation: Dimetrodon lived millions of years before the first dinosaurs and is more closely related to mammals.

options.text: Not a dinosaur: it lived before the first dinosaurs

questions.text: Which living animals are the closest relatives of dinosaurs?
questions.explanation: Birds are living dinosaurs; they evolved from small feathered dinosaurs.

questions.text: Archaeopteryx is an animal that links which two groups?
questions.explanation: It had feathers like a bird, but teeth and a long bony tail like a dinosaur.

questions.text: Which period did Tyrannosaurus rex live in?
questions.explanation: T. rex lived late in the Cretaceous period.

questions.text: Which period did Brachiosaurus live in?
questions.explanation: Brachiosaurus lived in the Jurassic period, long before T. rex.

questions.text: Which period did Dilophosaurus live in?
questions.explanation: Dilophosaurus lived early in the Jurassic period.

questions.text: Which two dinosaurs in the park lived tens of millions of years apart?
questions.explanation: Brachiosaurus lived in the Jurassic period; T. rex lived tens of millions of years later, in the Cretaceous.

questions.text: When did the first dinosaurs appear?
questions.explanation: The first dinosaurs appeared about 230 million years ago.

questions.text: What is thought to have ended the non-bird dinosaurs?
questions.explanation: The leading theory is an asteroid strike about 66 million years ago.

questions.text: Which dinosaur was a good parent that cared for its babies in nests?
questions.explanation: Maiasaura means 'good mother lizard'. Fossil nests show that parents cared for the hatchlings.

questions.text: What did T. rex eat?
questions.explanation: T. rex was a meat-eater.

questions.text: What did Triceratops eat?
questions.explanation: Triceratops was a plant-eater.

questions.text: What did Parasaurolophus eat?
questions.explanation: Parasaurolophus was a plant-eater.

questions.text: What shape were the teeth of T. rex?
questions.explanation: T. rex had big, curved teeth that could crush bone.

options.text: Large and curved, roughly like bananas

questions.text: Which dinosaur is one of the largest land animals ever known?
questions.explanation: Argentinosaurus was a huge long-necked plant-eater from South America.

questions.text: Which dinosaur is thought to have eaten fish?
questions.explanation: Spinosaurus is thought to have eaten fish.

questions.text: Which period did Stegosaurus live in?
questions.explanation: Stegosaurus lived late in the Jurassic period.

questions.text: Which period did Triceratops live in?
questions.explanation: Triceratops lived late in the Cretaceous period.

questions.text: Which period did Velociraptor live in?
questions.explanation: Velociraptor lived late in the Cretaceous period.

questions.text: What is a fossil?
questions.explanation: Fossils show what ancient life looked like.

options.text: Preserved remains or traces of ancient life
A living plant in a museum

questions.text: What is DNA?
questions.explanation: DNA is the code in every living cell, and it is what the park's scientists try to copy.

options.text: The instructions inside living cells that tell a body how to grow

questions.text: What is an embryo?
questions.explanation: An embryo is the earliest stage of an animal, before it hatches or is born.

options.text: An early stage of an animal's development

questions.text: What is a hybrid animal?
questions.explanation: The Indominus rex is a hybrid made from the DNA of several animals.

options.text: An animal made from the DNA of more than one species

questions.text: What is extinction?
questions.explanation: Dinosaurs became extinct about 66 million years ago, apart from birds.

options.text: When a whole kind of living thing dies out for good
When a dinosaur hatches from an egg
